name: Magnetic Save the Date with Envelope
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Wooden Piece: Made from premium 3mm wood with a smooth finish.

- Card: High-quality paper card with vivid UV print.

- Magnet Backing: Strong, durable adhesive magnet attached to the back of the wooden piece.

- Envelope Options: Available in Light Khaki, Black, and White paper envelopes.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in two convenient shapes Horizontal or Vertical:

 - Wooden Magnet: 3.5 × 3.5 inches ~ 8.89 × 8.89 cm or 3.5 × 4.5 inches ~ 8.89 × 11.43 cm

 - Card Size: 3.94 × 5.9 inches ~ 10 × 15 cm

 - Envelope Size (All Colors): 6.06 × 4.17 inches ~ 15.4 × 10.6 cm

 

  • Printing Technology:

- UV Printing for sharp, high-resolution, and vivid colors.

- Wooden magnet printed on one side only, back side has a magnetic square patch.

- Card is printed on one side, showcasing the design and date.

 

  • Functionality Use:

- Acts as a “Save the Date” wedding magnet that guests can stick on fridges or magnetic surfaces.

- Combines keepsake quality with functional use as a stylish reminder.

- Includes an envelope for elegant mailing or hand delivery.

- Ideal for mailing to guests or adding to wedding welcome packages.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

- Ideal for weddings, engagement announcements, bridal showers, or special celebrations.

- Memorable and personalized way to invite or remind guests.

- Suitable for people of all ages and any celebration theme.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x  Magnetic Save the Date with Envelope (Included: Envelop + Card)

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
